entities.name: Joseph Bùi Công Trác
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Bùi Công Trác is a Vietnamese prelate who serves as auxiliary bishop of the Hồ Chí Minh City. He was ordained a priest in 1999 and was rector of Saint Joseph Major Seminary of Sài Gòn from 2016 to 2024.
